title: A Failing Test File for search_memory
description: A pytest file that states the contract for search_memory as five tests, written before any implementation exists. Running it now shows the red phase.

steps.description: This is a test file. It imports `pytest` and defines `CORPUS`, the in-memory list of text documents the function will search.
`CORPUS` holds five documents, each a plain string: library hours, first-year vehicles, Wismer dining, the writing seminar, and the Bakes Center.
`search_memory` is a stub. Its body raises `NotImplementedError`, and the comment says the agent will replace this. That is why the tests fail first.

The first two tests cover AC-1 and AC-2. `test_returns_k_results` checks that `k=2` returns exactly 2 results, and `test_results_are_from_corpus` checks that every returned string is in `CORPUS`, so no hallucinated text is returned.
The last three tests cover AC-3, AC-4, and AC-5. Each uses `pytest.raises(ValueError)` to require an error for `k` larger than the corpus, for an empty query string, and for `k=0`.

steps.question: The page says running pytest on this file before any implementation shows how many FAILED lines?
